decisions.decision: Grain includes accession_number — preserves all filing versions
decisions.rationale: Amendments produce separate rows with their own accession_number. Deduplication to 'latest value' is a consumable zone concern. Base zone preserves the full filing history for auditability.

decisions.decision: Denormalize entity + concept fields into financial_facts
decisions.rationale: Avoids JOINs for common queries. ~547K rows x ~28 cols is small enough that denormalization has negligible storage cost. Every fact carries its entity name, ticker, business term mapping, and tier without needing to join back to dimension tables.

decisions.decision: No staging/approval gate — join is deterministic
decisions.rationale: Unlike entity resolution and tag normalization which require human judgment, the financial facts join is purely mechanical: CIK → entity_mappings, concept → concept_mappings. Both upstream tables are already approved. No human decision needed.

decisions.decision: Fiscal calendar built from observed data, not computed from fiscal_year_end
decisions.rationale: Don't guess period boundaries — extract actual (start_date, end_date) ranges from filings. Companies with fiscal year changes, short periods, or transition quarters are captured correctly because we observe what was actually filed.

decisions.decision: Keep all taxonomies (us-gaap, dei, invest, srt), not just us-gaap
decisions.rationale: dei/invest/srt facts are small (~2K) but may be useful downstream for entity metadata enrichment or investment-specific metrics. Filtering is trivial; excluding data is irreversible.

decisions.decision: Supersession by filed_date, not form type
decisions.rationale: A 10-K/A supersedes a 10-K, but also a later 10-K can report the same fact with a different value. filed_date is the universal authority for 'which filing is newer'. Form type is used only for is_amendment flag.

decisions.decision: Unmapped concepts get tier=3, financial_statement=other, category=uncategorized
decisions.rationale: Facts for concepts not in concept_mappings still need category/tier values for downstream filtering. Using explicit defaults makes these queryable without NULL handling. Consistent with tag normalization's tier 3 treatment.

decisions.decision: Post-implementation governance review: APPROVED with advisory findings
decisions.rationale: All governance artifacts present and complete (lineage, DQ rules, scorecard, audit trail, data dictionary). All three data models (conceptual, logical, physical) are APPROVED and consistent with each other and implementation. Business glossary terms approved. DQ rules validate real behavior. No implementation changes during backfill. Two advisory findings: (1) Business glossary lacks explicit mappings for the 3 new base tables (business terms traceable through lineage), (2) README has stale counts and missing spec in Phase 2 table (data model diagrams are present and current). Neither advisory blocks approval.
